name: layout-page-templates
summary: The canonical page types ObserveOps repeats, as annotated wireframes inside the app frame — built from the composition recipes. List view (header + toolbar + table + pager) · Form view (field grid) · Detail view (header + tabs + panels) · Dashboard view (picker + time range + widget grid) · Explorer view (left tree/filter + query + results) · Wizard flow (stepper + step + Back/Next) · Graph / Canvas (tree + interactive node graph).

template.note: which page template wireframe to show

do: Assemble pages from these archetypes + the per-region component mapping (recipes.json).
Use the List view for the most common index pages; Form/Detail for records.
Graph/Canvas (topology) is its own archetype — not a Dashboard or Explorer.
dont: Don't invent a new page shape where one of these seven fits.
Don't put a second scrolling region inside the body.

a11y.summary: Composition references — each template names the component per region; those components carry the semantics, headings and tab order.

knownIssues: Wireframes, not live pages — assemble from the per-region components (recipes.json).

[element] The obs-layout-* WEB COMPONENT is a fixed visual demo, not a slotted layout primitive — you can't put a real page inside it. Use the layout GUIDANCE (decisionFlow/regions) + compose the shell from atoms + the 12-col grid + tokens.
changelog: 2026-06-29: fixed Detail/Explorer/Graph body panes collapsing to zero height (align-items).
whenToUse: Pick the page archetype that matches the task, then assemble it from the per-region components (recipes).
usedIn: List view — inventory / alert / policy lists.
Form view — monitor / policy / credential forms · Detail view — monitor / alert detail.
Dashboard view — dashboards / NOC · Explorer view — log / metric explorers.
Wizard flow — discovery / report setup / 2FA · Graph / Canvas — topology.
decisionFlow: Browsing/managing MANY records (a list you filter, sort, page)? -> List view (list-view recipe).
Create or edit ONE record? -> Form view (form-view) — off a list use a Drawer; complex/settings forms use a full page.
Viewing ONE record's details (status + related tabs)? -> Detail view (detail-view).
Metrics / an at-a-glance overview? -> Dashboard (dashboard-view, tiles).
Querying/exploring a dataset (filters + results, e.g. logs)? -> Explorer (explorer-view).
Pick the archetype by what the page is FOR; don't invent a new page shape where one of these seven fits.
